title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, University Of California on 1982-05-22

ai_review.summary: Professional remastered soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1982 show with splendid playing and a powerful Jack Straw opener.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the band’s engaging, fine‑tuned performance throughout, calling it a "splendid run" with high energy that carried them into the fall. The recording is noted as a professional Jeff Norman remaster, delivering crystal‑clear soundboard quality. No specific flaws are mentioned, making this both an enjoyable musical and listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights excellent show energy and a professionally remastered soundboard, suggesting both high musical and technical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Professional remaster by Jeff Norman; crisp, clear mix with no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Specific set details not given; reviewer notes consistent high energy and strong playing throughout the concert.
